fields.body_md:
## About this programme

Thinking of an MSc in data science at Sheffield? Here is what it costs, who can get in and the 2027 dates.

The Sheffield MSc Data Science is a one-year, full-time course. It is taught in the School of Information, Journalism and Communication, part of the Faculty of Social Sciences. Teaching begins in September 2027.

**The most important fact for you:** the entry bar is a 2:1 in **any subject**, which Sheffield's India page puts at about **60%**.

You learn data science concepts and how to support data-driven problem solving in organisations and society. An Industry Week puts you face-to-face with sector leaders, and the course teaches you to use algorithms ethically and responsibly.

For the wider university, see our [University of Sheffield page](/study-abroad/universities/university-of-sheffield).

## Can you get in?

**Degree.** You need a minimum **2:1** undergraduate honours degree in any subject. A 2:1 is a UK honours grade. Sheffield may consider applicants with other relevant experience.

**Indian marks.** Sheffield's India page lists a 2:1 as **60%**, a first class as **65%** and a 2:2 as **55%**. It adds that the score needed depends on the university you attended and the course. It asks you to upload a grading key that converts your GPA to a percentage. A 2:1 is a UK honours grade.

**References.** Sheffield does not ask for references or a supporting statement for this course.

**GRE.** The course page does not mention GRE. GRE is a US-style graduate admissions test.

**English.** IELTS is an English language test. You need **IELTS 6.5** overall with **6** in each component.

**ATAS.** ATAS (Academic Technology Approval Scheme) is a UK security clearance that some science and technology courses need before you get a visa. Sheffield's course page does not say whether this course needs it. Your offer letter will say if you need ATAS clearance. Sheffield advises applying by **16 August 2027** if you do. If it is needed, an ATAS application takes at least **30 working days**.

## What it costs

Tuition for overseas students is **£36,055** for 2027-28. The page labels it the fee for the 1-year full-time MSc.

Sheffield is outside London, so the outside-London visa rule applies. This is the worked first-year total.

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Tuition for international students, 2027-28 | £36,055 |
| Living money you must show for your visa: £1,171 × 9 months | £10,539 |
| Student visa application fee, from outside the UK | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge for a visa of just over a year | £1,164 |
| **Total** | **£48,316** |

The sum is £36,055 + £10,539 + £558 + £1,164 = £48,316. Travel and housing are not included.

**Living money is money you show, not a fee.** The visa rule is **£1,171** for each month of your course outside London, up to **9 months**. You must hold this money for **28 days** in a row. The 28-day period must end within **31 days** of the date you apply. You do not pay it to the university.

**Health surcharge.** The Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) is a charge for using the NHS while you are in the UK. It is set by the length of your visa, not your course. For a course of 12 months or longer, the visa adds up to **1 month** before and **4 months** after the course. That makes a visa of more than a year but under 18 months. You then pay the yearly **£776** plus half of it, **£388**, so **£1,164**.

**Deposit.** Sheffield normally asks international applicants to pay a tuition fee deposit after they accept an unconditional offer. The amount and deadline are in your offer letter, so no deposit is added to the total. There is no application fee. You need a CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) for your visa. This is the electronic letter your university issues.

For the visa steps, read the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To plan the whole budget, use the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Funding

Sheffield has an automatic **£7,000** tuition fee reduction for postgraduate taught students from India and ten other countries or regions. You do not apply. To qualify you must:

- start a full-time postgraduate taught degree in September 2027
- have lived in India for the last three years
- be self-funded and pay overseas fees
- accept your offer before **4pm UK time on Tuesday 6 July 2027**

The award cannot be combined with other University scholarships or discounts, or with funding from an external sponsor. A loan that you repay in full does not count. See the [scholarship page](https://sheffield.ac.uk/international/fees-and-funding/scholarships/postgraduate/2027).

Sheffield graduates are entitled to a tuition discount worth up to £2,500. The page does not say whether it can be combined with the £7,000 award.

## Deadlines and intakes

Sheffield publishes university-wide dates, not course-specific ones. Applications for September 2027 close on **Friday 3 September 2027** at 17:00 British Summer Time. If you need a visa, the last date to apply is **Thursday 26 August 2027**. Teaching begins on **27 September 2027**. To get the scholarship you must accept your offer by **6 July 2027**, so apply well before the closing dates. All postgraduate taught master's courses at Sheffield start in September, so a January or February start is not confirmed for these courses.

## How to apply

1. **Check the entry rules.** You need a 2:1, about 60% in India, in any subject.
2. **Apply online.** Start from the [course page](https://sheffield.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/courses/2027/data-science-msc). Apply before **26 August 2027** if you need a visa. There is no application fee.
3. **Accept your offer.** Accept before **6 July 2027** to qualify for the £7,000 award.
4. **Pay the deposit.** Follow the amount and date in your offer letter.
5. **Check ATAS.** Your offer letter will say if you need ATAS clearance.
6. **Apply for your visa.** You need your CAS, a current passport, proof of funds and your tuberculosis (TB) test result. India is on the UK's TB test list. The test must be at a clinic approved by the Home Office. Read the [TB test page](https://www.gov.uk/tb-test-visa/countries-where-you-need-a-tb-test-to-enter-the-uk) and the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide).

## After the programme

- **Work in the UK after your course.** The Graduate Route lets you stay and work in the UK after your studies. The visa lasts **2 years** if you apply on or before **31 December 2026**, and **18 months** if you apply on or after **1 January 2027**. A September 2027 student applies in 2028, so expect 18 months. The application fee is **£937**.


## Who it suits

**This programme is a strong choice if:**

- you have a degree in any subject at about 60% or more
- you want a data science master's focused on responsible use of data
- you want an automatic £7,000 award with no separate form

**Think carefully if:**

- you want a course taught in a computer science school, because this one sits in the information school
- you need a January or February start, because none is confirmed
- you plan to combine awards, because the £7,000 award cannot be combined with other University awards

- [Immigration Rules, Appendix Student](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/immigration-rules/immigration-rules-appendix-student). Checked on 4 November 2026.

faq_json.q: How much does the Sheffield MSc Data Science cost for Indian students?
faq_json.a: Tuition is £36,055 for 2027-28. With visa living money, the visa fee and the health surcharge, the first year comes to £48,316, or £41,316 after the automatic £7,000 scholarship.

faq_json.q: What percentage do Indian students need for Sheffield MSc Data Science?
faq_json.a: Sheffield's India page lists a 2:1 as 60%, and the course needs a 2:1 in any subject. The score depends on your university and the course.

faq_json.q: Does Sheffield need GRE for MSc Data Science?
faq_json.a: The course page does not mention GRE. It asks for IELTS 6.5 overall with 6 in each component, and it asks for no references.

faq_json.q: What is the deadline for Sheffield MSc Data Science 2027?
faq_json.a: Applications close on 3 September 2027. If you need a visa, the last date to apply is 26 August 2027.

faq_json.q: Is there a scholarship for Indian students at Sheffield?
faq_json.a: Yes. Sheffield gives an automatic £7,000 tuition reduction to self-funded offer-holders who have lived in India for three years. Accept your offer by 6 July 2027.
